# Dueling Domain

> Dueling Domain is a free, fan-made Yu-Gi-Oh! simulator in the browser for drafts, tournaments and automated online duels with friends.

Run cube and booster drafts with virtual packs, a pick clock and deck building. Online duels use the EDOPro rules engine: 1v1, 2v2 Tag and 3-4 player free-for-all, Domain Format with a Deck Master in its own zone, and Genesys points decks.

The closed alpha is free and invitation-only. Joining the waitlist does not guarantee access; invitations are sent in waves. The app requires sign-in and is excluded from search indexing.

Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami. Contact: support@duelingdomain.com.

## Product and access

- [Home](https://duelingdomain.com/): Product overview and closed alpha waitlist.
- [FAQ](https://duelingdomain.com/#faq): Price, browser play, 3- and 4-player and Tag duels, rules engine, Domain Format, Genesys, cube drafts and the unofficial status.
- [App sign-in](https://app.duelingdomain.com): Sign in to the invitation-only app. Private app content is not a public source.
